root_cause.text: The error handling path in `idpf_plug_vport_aux_dev()` and `idpf_plug_core_aux_dev()` falls through from the `err_aux_dev_add` label to `err_aux_dev_init` after `auxiliary_device_uninit()` frees the device, causing a use-after-free when reading `adev->id` and a double free when `kfree(iadev)` is called again.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains: “When auxiliary_device_add() fails ... the err_aux_dev_add label calls auxiliary_device_uninit() and falls through to err_aux_dev_init. The uninit call will trigger put_device(), which invokes the release callback ... that frees iadev. The fall-through then reads adev->id from the freed iadev for ida_free() and double-frees iadev with kfree().” The patch adds `ida_free()` and clears the back-pointer before `auxiliary_device_uninit()`, then returns immediately to prevent the fall-through.
